pending.long: A new instruction arrived. Waiting for the owner to give a new report estimate.

timeView.axisAbsent: The time view is not saved on this device. It loads when the connection is back.
timeView.help: Scroll sideways to move through time. Zoom with ctrl (⌘) + wheel, a pinch, or two fingers. Double-click the time scale to see everything. Point at a line (tap on a phone) for details. Keys: + − 0 N; press → on a title to read its lines in turn.

decide.label: Pick a mini game idea, then have it built
decide.shows: AI compares ideas and asks you a question. Your answer starts the build.
decide.words: I'd like to make one mini game I can play in the browser. Make it a task: list 3 ideas, and ask me which to build, with a comparison table and your recommendation in the question. Once I answer, build the one I chose in about 5 minutes without asking anything else, and report back. This is a tutorial, so keep the effort light: go for speed, don't overthink it, and take it easy. Please write everything in English.

models.label: Have 3 models build a snake game, then pick one
models.shows: Different models build in parallel, then you pick the one to keep.
models.words: I'd like to make a snake game. Could you try building 3 in parallel with different models? When they're done, ask me which one to go with. This is a tutorial, so please keep the effort light and take about 5 minutes. Please write everything in English.

triage.label: Split a café opening into 5 tasks
triage.shows: The results line up for your review, and you choose which to complete.
triage.words: Please split a fictional café's opening into 5 separate tasks: "Order the beans", "Arrange the sign", "Print the menu", "Hire staff" and "Send the invitations", and give each one to an agent. Have each write a one-line fictional result in its report and wait for my review. Once all 5 are in, I'll choose which to complete. No research or files needed, and please write everything in English.
